question: Which of the following states has won the 2022 Santosh Trophy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**K**____**arnataka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** 2022 Santosh Trophy:-**

 
 
• **It was the 76th edition of the Santosh Trophy, the premier competition in India for teams representing their regional and state football associations. **
 
• The tournament was held from 23 December 2022 to 4 March 2023, with the final being played at the King Fahd Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
 
• The tournament was contested by a total of 36 teams, which were divided into six groups of six teams each.
 
• **Karnataka won the 2022 Santosh Trophy, defeating Meghalaya in the final with 3-2 scoreline.**
